snippet.title: Quest Master | Halloween Update | Out Now!
snippet.description:
🎃 Play Now: ► apo.gg/QuestMaster
Get ready for thrills and chills in Quest Master’s latest update, Version 0.9.3! This Halloween-themed update transforms Castle Town into a spooky spectacle, filled with exclusive rewards like the Halloween Badge and eerie encounters with Jack the Reaper. Dive into the new Moonlight Brambles dungeon theme, a haunted twist on the classic Dewdrop Roots, complete with gravestones, gargoyle statues, and a spine-tingling soundtrack. Plus, experience major upgrades to our Logic system with new Condition Variants, Shape Inversions, and more! Perfect for fans of Zelda-like Maker experiences, this update adds endless creativity and Halloween spirit to your dungeon-making.
Moonlight Brambles, a spooky dungeon theme that’s here to stay! Join the event before it ends on November 30th! 🎃
